info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Airline Flights Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Airline Flight Status API provides real-time status information for flights operated by various airlines. Users can query the status of specific flights, including details such as departure and arrival times, delays, and cancellations. This API is primarily designed for travel agencies, airline operators, and applications that require up-to-date flight information to enhance user experience. By accessing this data, developers can build applications that inform travelers about their flight status and help them better prepare for their journeys.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of a flight.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to check the current status of a specific flight, including details such as departure and arrival times, gate information, and any delays or cancellations.
